================================================================================
Comment begins immediately after a keyword
================================================================================
!a# hi
b
---
(program (keyword) (comment) (word))

================================================================================
Keyword followed by a word without a comment
================================================================================
!a b
---
(program (keyword) (word))

================================================================================
Comment-like continuation stays inside a whole word
================================================================================
a#tail
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Comment cannot replace the required following word
:error
================================================================================
!a# hi
---
(program (keyword) (comment) (MISSING word))

================================================================================
An unrelated word cannot replace the keyword
:error
================================================================================
!z b
---
(program (ERROR (word)) (word))
